# Futurise Solutions

> Futurise Solutions is a full-cycle digital product studio that designs, builds, and scales AI, web, mobile, and Web3 products. We help startup founders, SaaS companies, and enterprises take an idea from concept to scaled production. Futurise Solutions is headquartered in Wellington, New Zealand. Client projects have been delivered in the United Arab Emirates, the United States and India; the company also serves New Zealand and Canada.

## What we do

Futurise Solutions offers six core services, end-to-end (strategy, design, engineering, and growth):

- **AI & ML Solutions** — [/service/ai-ml-solutions](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/ai-ml-solutions): Custom AI agents, LLM and RAG integrations, NLP pipelines, and computer vision. We are model-agnostic (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama) and build for production, not demos.
- **Web Development** — [/service/web-development](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/web-development): Custom websites, SaaS platforms, dashboards, and APIs with React, Next.js, Node.js, and GraphQL. SEO-ready, sub-2-second load times, scalable architecture.
- **App Development** — [/service/app-development](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo from a single codebase, with Firebase/Supabase backends, payments, push, and maps.
- **UI/UX Design** — [/service/ui-ux-design](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/ui-ux-design): UX research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma UI, interactive prototypes, and design systems (WCAG 2.1) that cut churn and lift conversions.
- **Blockchain Development** — [/service/blockchain-development](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/blockchain-development): Audited smart contracts, DeFi platforms, MEV bots, and multi-chain dApps across Ethereum, BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Solana.
- **Digital Marketing** — [/service/digital-marketing](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/service/digital-marketing): SEO, performance and paid social advertising, conversion rate optimisation (CRO), and analytics — tied to revenue, not vanity metrics.

## Technologies we use

React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Python, React Native, Expo, GraphQL, REST, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD.

## Industries we serve

SaaS, startups, FinTech, healthcare, real estate and PropTech, e-commerce, education, hospitality, and enterprise software.

## Key facts

- Type: Full-cycle digital product studio / software development company
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Wellington, New Zealand
- Primary markets: New Zealand, United Arab Emirates, United States, Canada, India
- Client work delivered in: United Arab Emirates (Dubai), United States, India
- Track record: the portfolio page lists the engagements we can name. We publish no project or client totals, because a count is not something a reader can verify and we would rather be checked than believed
- Disciplines in-house: AI & ML, web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, blockchain, digital marketing
- Engagement model: Free discovery call, fixed-scope estimates, two-week agile sprints; NDAs signed on request; post-launch support and maintenance available
- Typical timelines: MVPs 6–12 weeks; larger platforms 3–6 months

## Selected work

Named clients with delivered, verifiable projects:

- HOMIES — property management and analytics SaaS dashboard (PropTech, USA & India)
- Marty-QR — AI-powered review management platform (SaaS, USA & India)
- David Tishbi — luxury jewelry e-commerce storefront (USA)

- GDT Exchange — crypto perpetuals trading terminal (FinTech / Web3, USA & India)
- Platinum Peak — direct hotel booking experience (hospitality, India & USA)

## Common questions

- **Where is Futurise Solutions based?** Futurise Solutions is headquartered in the Huddart Parker Building, Wellington Central, Wellington 6011, New Zealand.
- **Which countries does Futurise Solutions work with?** Primary markets are New Zealand, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Canada and India. Client projects have been delivered in Dubai (UAE), the United States and India.
- **Does Futurise Solutions work with clients in the UAE?** Yes. Infinity Bay Trading, a Dubai-based B2B supply company, is a Futurise Solutions client whose website was rebuilt on Astro for speed and search visibility.
- **Does Futurise Solutions work with clients in New Zealand?** Yes. The company is headquartered in Wellington, New Zealand and works with New Zealand businesses; published client projects to date are in the UAE, the United States and India.
- **What does Futurise Solutions build?** AI agents and LLM/RAG integrations, SaaS platforms, websites and web apps, cross-platform iOS and Android apps, UI/UX design systems, smart contracts and Web3 dApps, and SEO and performance marketing programmes.
- **How do I get a quote from Futurise Solutions?** Book a free discovery call at https://www.futurisesolutions.com/contact or email business@futurisesolutions.com. Estimates are fixed-scope and provided after the discovery call.
- **How long does a project take?** MVPs typically take 6–12 weeks; larger platforms typically take 3–6 months.
- **What technologies does Futurise Solutions use?** React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React Native, Expo, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, Solidity, AWS and Vercel.

## Case Studies

Engineering write-ups of how each system was built — architecture, tradeoffs and what we
would do differently. They describe the work, not its commercial results: we do not publish
performance figures we cannot ask a reader to verify.

- [Case Studies Index](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies) — All published case studies.
- [AI Customer Support Agent](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/ai-support-agent) — A retrieval-augmented support agent for a US SaaS company: documentation embedded into a vector index, grounded generation, and a confidence threshold that escalates to a human rather than guessing.
- [SaaS Platform Scale](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/saas-platform-scale) — Rebuilding a B2B PropTech dashboard inherited as an unscalable prototype: N+1 query elimination, caching and index work.
- [Real Estate Mobile App](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/real-estate-app) — A cross-platform React Native property app built to stay usable on low-end Android hardware as well as current iPhones.
- [FinTech Dashboard Redesign](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/fintech-ux-redesign) — Research-led information-architecture rework and a reusable component system for a wealth-management dashboard.
- [DeFi Protocol Launch](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/defi-protocol-launch) — Solidity staking and liquidity contracts rewritten for an external audit, and the architecture decisions behind them.
- [SaaS SEO Growth](https://www.futurisesolutions.com/case-studies/saas-seo-growth) — The technical SEO method applied to a B2B compliance SaaS: crawl and indexation work, content architecture, internal linking and schema.
